faq_heading: Homes near Adams Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Adams Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Adams Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Adams Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Adams Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 110 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,310,250, townhomes $745,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Adams Road Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Adams Road Elementary the median was 16 days on the market, closing at 97.4% of the list price, with 9% of sales above the list price for the 110 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Adams Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Hillcrest Elementary (0.9 km south-east), Don Christian Elementary (1.1 km south) and Ecole Salish Secondary (1.1 km north).

Adams Road Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 18228 68 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Adams Road Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Adams Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Adams Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Adams Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 110 homes sold within 1 km of Adams Road Elementary: 54 houses and 51 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,310,250.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Adams Road Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Adams Road Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Hillcrest Elementary, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is Maddaugh Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Bibleway Christian Academy (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hillcrest Elementary (0.9 km south-east), Don Christian Elementary (1.1 km south), Regent Road Elementary (1.6 km north-east), Hazelgrove Elementary (1.8 km east), Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.9 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hillcrest Elementary, 0.9 km south-east of Adams Road Elementary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Adams Road Elementary was $1,310,250, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Hillcrest Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.9 km south-east of Adams Road Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
